settingsHint: Is device ya configured speech service ki asli awaaz chunein.
voiceUnavailable: Is bhasha ki awaaz nahi hai. Jawab text mein dikhega.
voiceFallback: Chuni hui awaaz is bhasha mein nahi hai. Compatible device awaaz use ho rahi hai.
cloudConsentHint: Sirf abhi ki baat ya chhota jawab configured speech service ko bhejein. DukaanSet raw recording save nahi karta.
autoLanguage: Shuruaat app language mein hogi. Clear speech conversation language set karti hai; short replies usi mein rehte hain.
deviceRecognition: Device abhi ki conversation bhasha mein sunta hai. Automatic multilingual recognition ke liye configured speech service chahiye.
recording: Aapki baat record ho rahi hai…
quickHint: Ek kaam, chhota jawab, phir check karke save karein.
talkHint: Bolein, sunein aur naturally jawab dein. Shuru karne ke liye mic dabayein.
aiVoice: Assistant ki awaaz machine se bani hai.
textFallback: Awaaz nahi chal saki. Jawab padhein aur type karke aage badhein.
previewText: Namaste! Main aapka DukaanSet assistant hoon. Batayein, dukaan mein kya kaam hai?
permissionHint: Browser mein mic allow karein. Listening rokne ya VoiceOS band karne par mic band ho jata hai.
costUnavailable: Kharcha estimate karne ke liye service rates set karein. Asli billing provider deta hai.
welcome: Namaste! Aaj main aapki kya help kar sakta hoon?
askStockItems: Stock mein kaunsa samaan aur kitni quantity jodni hai?
askProduct: Kaunsa product chahiye? Neeche sahi product chunein.
askUnit: Kaunsi unit hai: piece, packet ya kilo?
askPayment: Total {{total}} hua. Cash mila, UPI ya udhaar?
askCustomer: Kaunsa customer hai? Neeche sahi account chunein.
askAmount: Kitne rupaye mile ya kharch hue?
askAmbiguous: Bill banana hai ya stock add karna hai? Alag-alag products hain ya ek product ki quantity hai?
askMeaning: Naam se product banana hai ya product recommendation chahiye?
askReview: Aage badhne se pehle bataye gaye details check karein.
askUnknown: Kaam batayein, jaise bill banana, stock jodna ya payment lena.
insufficient: {{product}} ka sirf {{quantity}} {{unit}} stock hai. Quantity ghatayein ya pehle stock jodein.
readySale: {{customer}} ka bill ready hai: total {{total}}, cash {{cash}}, UPI {{upi}} aur udhaar {{credit}}. Save kar doon?
readyStock: Stock ke {{count}} products ready hain. Quantity aur rate check karke save bolein ya Save All Stock dabayein.
readyCustomer: {{name}} customer add karne ke liye ready hai. Save kar doon?
readyProduct: {{name}} product bina opening stock ke ready hai. Save kar doon?
readyPayment: {{customer}} se {{method}} ke zariye mile {{amount}} record karne hain? Check karke save bolein.
readyExpense: {{name}} ka {{amount}} kharcha ready hai. Save kar doon?
reviewWorkflow: Yeh kaam taiyaar hai. Kholkar details check karein aur uska confirm button dabayein.
confirmedSale: {{customer}} ka {{number}} bill save ho gaya. Total {{total}} aur {{credit}} udhaar baaki hai. Stock aur customer ka account update ho gaya.
confirmedStock: Stock save ho gaya. {{count}} products update hue.
confirmedProduct: {{name}} bina opening stock ke save ho gaya.
confirmedPayment: Mila hua payment save ho gaya aur customer ka account update ho gaya.
errorDraft: Kaam poora nahi ho saka. Draft check karne aur retry ke liye abhi bhi hai.
errorPending: Server ka result abhi pakka nahi hai. Saved request safe hai; usi ko check ya retry karein.
notReady: Pehle missing details poori karein. Abhi kuch save nahi hua.
cancelled: Adhoora draft cancel ho gaya. Shop ke records nahi badle.
stopNotice: Baatcheet ruk gayi. Aapka draft abhi bhi hai.
closingResult: {{date}} ke liye sale {{sales}} aur collection {{collections}} hai.
cloudNotConfigured: Cloud speech configured nahi hai. Device speech aur typing available hain.
ended: Baatcheet band ho gayi. Aapke saved records safe hain.
speaker: Aap
finalizing: Aapka sentence complete kar rahe hain…
waiting: Aapke next step ke liye ready
autoEndHint: Aaraam se boliye. Baat khatam hone par microphone apne aap rukega.
askShopScope: Main aapki active shop ke customers check kar sakta hoon. Kya aap shop ke customer records pooch rahe hain? Duniya bhar ka customer count verify nahi kar sakta.
customerExists: {{name}} naam ka customer pehle se hai. Usi ko kholna hai ya same naam se alag customer banana hai?
readySeparateCustomer: {{name}} ka alag customer ready hai. Save kar doon?
handsFreeHint: Aaram se bolo. Har reply ke baad main phir sununga.
askPhone: Phone number check karo. Alag customer ke liye existing customer ka number use nahi kar sakte.
myVoiceApproximation: Chhoti recording se milti-julti awaaz ban sakti hai. Similarity aur language quality alag ho sakti hai.
myVoiceUnavailable: Is workspace mein My Voice abhi available nahi hai. Standard voices istemal kar sakte hain.
myVoiceVerifiedAccount: Apni awaaz banane ke liye verified personal account istemal karein. Yahan standard voices available hain.
myVoiceConsentNotice: Sirf apni awaaz record karein. Synthetic assistant voice banane ke liye recording verification aur voice provider ko jayegi. Assistant replies speech banane ke liye bheje jayenge. Awaaz baad mein delete kar sakte hain.
myVoiceConsent: Yeh meri apni awaaz hai. Main verification, synthetic voice banane aur assistant replies mein istemal ki sahmati deta hoon.
myVoiceReadScript: Naye phrase ke saath naturally padhein
myVoiceAllowMic: Shuru karne ke liye microphone allow karein
myVoiceVerifying: Recording verify karke awaaz taiyar ho rahi hai…
myVoiceMicrophoneUnavailable: Microphone recording available nahi hai. Secure connection par supported browser kholein.
myVoicePermission: Browser settings mein microphone allow karke phir koshish karein.
myVoiceUnclear: Recording clear nahi thi. Shaant jagah par bina chillaye phir record karein.
myVoiceTooShort: Kam se kam 10 seconds saaf bolkar record karein. 12 seconds tak poora sentence padhein.
myVoiceRateLimit: Aaj awaaz banane ki limit poori ho gayi hai. Baad mein koshish karein.
myVoicePreferenceChanged: Voice settings badal gayi hain. Refresh karke phir chunein.
myVoiceVerificationFailed: Aapki apni awaaz aur sahmati verify nahi hui. Phir record karein aur naya phrase saaf padhein.
myVoicePreparing: Aapki AI awaaz taiyar ho rahi hai. Recording se zyada waqt lag sakta hai.
myVoiceReady: Aapki personal AI awaaz preview ke liye taiyar hai.
myVoiceLanguageReview: App ki current language mein sunkar approve karein. Doosri languages mein preview aur approval tak standard voice istemal hogi.
myVoiceActivated: Ab assistant aapki awaaz mein bolega.
myVoicePreviewFailed: Personal awaaz nahi chal saki. Preview phir try karein ya standard voice rakhein.
myVoiceGenerationFailed: Kaam ki awaaz nahi bani. Phir 10–15 seconds ki saaf recording karein.
myVoiceUncertain: Provider ka result clear nahi hai. Doosri recording se pehle status check karein ya yeh attempt delete karein.
myVoiceDeleteConfirm: Personal AI awaaz delete karein? Assistant standard voice mein bolega. Nayi awaaz se pehle provider deletion confirm hona zaroori hai.
myVoiceReplaceConfirm: Doosri recording se awaaz badlein? Pehle current profile delete hogi. Nayi awaaz bante waqt assistant standard voice istemal karega.
myVoiceDeletionPending: Aapki awaaz deactivate hai. Provider mein deletion abhi confirm nahi hui.
myVoiceDeleted: Personal awaaz delete ho gayi. Ab assistant standard voice istemal karega.
myVoiceCheckStatusHint: Provider ka status phir check karna hoga. Business records safe hain.
